import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODE = 5500;
    static final int MAX_EDGE = 35500;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Arc {
        int next;
        int dest;
        int cap;
        int cost;

        Arc(int next, int dest, int cap, int cost) {
            this.next = next;
            this.dest = dest;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static List<Arc> graph = new ArrayList<>(MAX_EDGE * 2 + 10);
    static List<Integer> adj = new ArrayList<>(MAX_NODE + 10);
    static int edge_cnt = 1;

    static void add_arc(int u, int v, int c, int w) {
        graph.add(new Arc(adj.get(u), v, c, w));
        adj.set(u, ++edge_cnt);
        graph.add(new Arc(adj.get(v), u, 0, -w));
        adj.set(v, ++edge_cnt);
    }

    static int s, t;
    static int[] prev_node = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] last_arc = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] flow_arr = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static int[] dist_arr = new int[MAX_NODE];
    static boolean[] in_q = new boolean[MAX_NODE];

    static int spfa_run() {
        Arrays.fill(dist_arr, 1, t + 1, INF);
        Arrays.fill(flow_arr, 1, t + 1, 0);
        flow_arr[s] = INF;
        dist_arr[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        in_q[s] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            in_q[u] = false;

            for (int e = adj.get(u); e != 0; e = graph.get(e).next) {
                int v = graph.get(e).dest;
                if (graph.get(e).cap > 0 && dist_arr[v] > dist_arr[u] + graph.get(e).cost) {
                    dist_arr[v] = dist_arr[u] + graph.get(e).cost;
                    flow_arr[v] = Math.min(flow_arr[u], graph.get(e).cap);
                    last_arc[v] = e;
                    prev_node[v] = u;
                    if (!in_q[v]) {
                        in_q[v] = true;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return flow_arr[t];
    }

    static int n, m, k, base_cost, unit_cost;
    static int[][] loc_record = new int[105][105];
    static int[][] edge_count_rec = new int[105][105];

    static class Journey {
        int src, dst;
        Journey(int src, int dst) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
        }
    }

    static Journey[] edges_in = new Journey[105];

    static int to_node(int r, int c) {
        return r * n + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        base_cost = sc.nextInt();
        unit_cost = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize graph and adjacency list
        graph.add(null); // index 0 unused
        adj.add(0); // index 0 unused
        for (int i = 1; i <= MAX_NODE; i++) {
            adj.add(0);
            graph.add(null);
        }

        s = to_node(n + k, n) + 1;
        t = s + 2;

        add_arc(to_node(0, 1), t, INF, 0);

        for (int i = 1, port; i <= k; ++i) {
            port = sc.nextInt();
            add_arc(s, to_node(0, port), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            int src = sc.nextInt();
            int dst = sc.nextInt();
            edges_in[i * 2] = new Journey(src, dst);
            edges_in[i * 2 - 1] = new Journey(dst, src);
        }
        m <<= 1;

        for (int day = 1; day <= n + k; ++day) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
                add_arc(to_node(day - 1, i), to_node(day, i), INF, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
                add_arc(to_node(day - 1, edges_in[i].src), to_node(day, edges_in[i].dst), 1, unit_cost);
                loc_record[day][i] = edge_cnt;
                edge_count_rec[day][i] = 1;
            }
            add_arc(to_node(day, 1), t, INF, day * base_cost);
        }

        int augment, total = 0;
        while ((augment = spfa_run()) > 0) {
            int cur = t;
            while (cur != s) {
                int u = prev_node[cur];
                graph.get(last_arc[cur]).cap -= augment;
                graph.get(last_arc[cur] ^ 1).cap += augment;
                cur = u;
            }
            total += dist_arr[t] * augment;

            for (int day = 1; day <= n + n; ++day)
                for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i)
                    if (graph.get(loc_record[day][i]).cap > 0) {
                        edge_count_rec[day][i]++;
                        add_arc(to_node(day - 1, edges_in[i].src), to_node(day, edges_in[i].dst), 1,
                                unit_cost * (edge_count_rec[day][i] * 2 - 1));
                        loc_record[day][i] = edge_cnt;
                    }
        }

        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
